adjudication.rationale: In GoogleCalendarService.updateEvent and deleteEvent the fallback when `externalCalendarId` is falsy was changed from using the event’s destination calendar externalId to `event.destinationCalendar?.find((cal) => cal.externalId === externalCalendarId)?.externalId`. When `externalCalendarId` is `null/undefined` (as for pre-existing bookingReference rows), the `find` predicate compares against the same falsy value and returns `undefined`, so the selected calendar id becomes `undefined` (or later falls back to `primary`), rather than the intended destination calendar. This breaks update/delete for events created on non-primary destination calendars unless `externalCalendarId` is populated.
